title: Towards More Standardized AI Evaluation: From Models to Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating pairwise comparisons by swapping presentation orders and averaging results (position switching) to detect and mitigate the judge model's preference for the first option presented.
Using length-controlled evaluation techniques (such as Length-Controlled AlpacaEval) to regress out the LLM judge's tendency to rate longer answers higher regardless of actual quality.
Assessing LLM-as-a-judge frameworks for their inherent tendency to rate outputs generated by their own model family higher than those from competing models.
Analyzing judge models to see if they systematically prefer answers that confirm their existing biases or that are stated assertively, even when those answers are factually incorrect.
